title: Skill
text: The next morning.
“It’s hot…”

I woke up when I noticed my father making sounds as if he were groaning in his sleep. When I sat up, Yuki and Kou were leaning against me, breathing softly in their sleep. “Where’s Sakura?” I wondered. When I turned toward my father, I saw Sakura lying on her back, in her Filolial Queen form, cradling him in her arms.
“Good morning, Father.”
When I sat up, Yuki and Kou woke up and blinked at me.
“Good morning, Motoyasu-sama.”
“Good morning, Kitamura.”
Yuki and the others greeted me. What a lovely morning.
“I wonder how long Father and Sakura were at it.”
I got out of bed and looked over at my father and Sakura. My father was muttering in his sleep, “It’s so hot… so hot…”
“Zzz… zzz…”
“Ugh… it’s hot.”
Eventually, my father woke up and seemed to realize what was going on.
“Sa, Sakura, make sure you follow Motoyasu-kun’s instructions properly…”
The floor was creaking, but I’m sure it’ll be fine.
“Aww…”
“Sakura! It’s almost time to get up.”
“Mmm…”
When Yuki-chan said that, Sakura slowly opened her eyes, yawned, and hugged Father from behind, rubbing her cheek against his.
“Good morning, Naofumi.”
“Good morning. But if you stay like that, you’ll bother the people around us, so please turn back into an angel.”
“Ugh… okay.”
Sakura-chan returned to her angel form just as Father told her to. Obeying Father… this, too, is part of my training as Filolial-sama.
“Naofumi, is this okay?”
“Yeah. That’s right.”
“Let’s sleep together again, okay?”
“You’re a little too hot… Also, the floor of the room feels like it’s about to cave in, so let’s save that for when we’re sleeping outdoors.”
“Got it! I can’t wait!”
“Hahaha, Sakura-chan really likes her Father, doesn’t she?”
“Yeah. Motoyasu told me to protect Naofumi, so Sakura’s gonna do her best!”

What a noble spirit. I, Motoyasu, am so moved that tears are welling up in my eyes. As long as I let Sakura-chan protect her Father, I have nothing to worry about. Her Father left the room and knocked on the door of the room next door.
“Ms. Éclair, how are you feeling?”
Saying that, he entered the room. I followed him inside, and Éclair, who had been breathing quietly in her sleep, seemed to wake up.
“Hmm… Ah, Lord Iwatani.”
“How are you? Can you get up?”
“I don’t think there’s… any problem.”

Then she shifted her gaze to the envoy from Siltvelt and the pig. They seemed to have woken up as well and noticed us. Their gaze, however, wasn’t directed at me or my Father, but rather at Yuki and the others.
“Who are those children?”
“They’re angels.”
“Motoyasu isn’t very good at explaining things, so please stay quiet for a bit.”
“Understood.”

Following Father’s instructions, I took a step back. All that was left was the simple task of keeping my mouth shut like a stone. My father-in-law placed his hand on Sakura-chan’s shoulder and replied.
“Um, these girls are the Filolials that Motoyasu-kun raised. It’d be a big hassle to have them transform right here in this room, so I’ll show you later—but I want you to trust me on this.”

Éclair and the others were so surprised their voices cracked. Well, I can’t say I don’t understand how they feel. The first time Filo-tan transformed, I let out a dazed gasp myself. After that, a shockwave ran through me as if time had stopped… Looking back now, I suppose it was a fateful encounter. Just remembering it sends a sharp pain shooting through my lower body.
“I’m sure it’s hard to believe… but I’ll show you proof right away.”
“O-okay.”
“Alright, everyone, please introduce yourselves again.”
At Father’s words, Yuki-chan and the others step forward and bow.
“I’m Yuki.”
“Kou.”
“Sakura.”
“So you can speak human language too… One surprise after another…”
Éclair is saying something rather rude, isn’t she? Is she implying that my Father looks like the sort of person who would lie? HAHAHA! My Father doesn’t lie. At least, not about that.
“W-well then, let’s get ready for the morning.”
The envoy from Siltvelt began to walk unsteadily, feigning composure.
After that, everyone had breakfast. We ordered a huge amount of food at the tavern next to the inn and ate together. Yuki-chan and the others were tucking in heartily.
“You sure do eat a lot.”
“Hmm… It’s not quite as good as the food Naofumi-sama makes, is it? Kou.”
“That’s true.”
“The stuff Naofumi makes is tastier, isn’t it?”
“I’m flattered to hear you say that, but…”
“Our food expenses are going to get out of hand…”
The mountain of food we ordered disappeared in the blink of an eye. Wow… watching Filolial-sama and the others eat like that really lifts my spirits. Éclair muttered, looking a bit troubled.
“In that case, I guess we’ll just have to ask Motoyasu and the others to procure it? It’d be great if we could sell the ingredients, though.”
“We can do that. I think we should just have the town’s buyers purchase the materials we’ve loaded onto the wagon.”
“Really? Then should we sell them before we leave to cover our travel expenses? I’m good at negotiating.”

Come to think of it, I recall Father saying he made quite a bit of money as a traveling merchant. He even had the slaves in that wonderful village work as traveling merchants and taught them the tricks of the trade for selling things at a high price.
“In that case, let’s leave it to Lord Iwatani.”
“Yeah. Oh, I went ahead and decided that on my own, but Motoyasu, what are you going to do today? I think our pursuers will be here any minute now.”
“I’d like to stick around here today and level up my Father. If we get him to Level 40 and strengthen him properly, we won’t have to worry about assassins anymore.”
“Got it. So, once we’ve secured some money, let’s go level him up.”
“Ugh…”
Éclair and the others look pale.
“Éclair, are you okay? If you want, maybe Sakura-chan and I can go without you?”
“W-well, that won’t do. We’re here to escort Lord Iwatani, after all.”
“I know, but—…”
My father is worried about Éclair. Is she getting motion sickness?
“It’s all a matter of getting used to it.”
“Y-yeah, you’re right… If I don’t get used to it, I’ll probably be sick the whole rest of the journey.”
The envoy from Siltvelt is glancing back and forth between my face and the pig.
“Oink!”
“I’ll be accompanying you this time, so you can focus on the Spear Hero…”

I got motion sickness at first, too. But that was part of my happy time with Filolial-sama. My body naturally got used to it, and I stopped getting sick. Ah, I felt a pang of nostalgia, wishing I could experience that motion sickness again in the carriage drawn by Filolial-sama.
“What are your plans for today, Motoyasu-kun?”

“I’ll ask someone in town to weave the thread made from Yuki-chan and the others’ Magical Power into cloth. After that, in my free time, I’ll go out to gather materials to reinforce Father’s shield, I suppose?”
“…Do you think we’ll be able to communicate to some extent before we leave?”
“I don’t think it’ll take that long to turn it into fabric, though…”
“Well then, we could take Yuki-chan and the others’ measurements and have some clothes tailored.”

I should be able to make clothes for Yuki-chan and the others when I have some free time. If I think about it that way, I should be able to buy the materials to strengthen Father’s weapon as well, right?
“So, Motoyasu-kun, are you going to make clothes for Sakura-chan and the others today? We could ask a clothing store… or a Tailor?　or something like that.”
“What are you talking about? It goes without saying that I’m the one who makes the clothes.”

Sewing clothes for Filolial-sama is my life’s work. Without that, I cannot show my love. To have Filolial-sama—who belongs to the most noble race—wear clothes into which I’ve poured my very soul… That is the supreme joy.
“O-oh, I see. So, Motoyasu-kun, your job today is to make clothes, then.”
“Understood.”

And just like that, my task for the day was set. I’ll turn the yarn spun by Yuki-chan and the others into fabric and make clothes. Before we set out, I’ll take their measurements. By the way, since the yarn was originally spun using Magical Power, I’ve found that once the clothes are made, the sizing is fairly flexible.
“A little more there!”
“G-… Alright. I can’t raise it any higher than this!”
“Sold!”

My father was engaged in a bidding war at a local dealer’s shop. This area is no longer under Melromarc’s jurisdiction; it’s a region that also trades with Siltvelt. With a Siltvelt envoy mediating to determine the market price—and assess the purchase price—they were locked in a heated battle. My father’s eyes were shining with excitement.
“Iwatani is amazing. He raised the price to double the market rate.”

“I feel like if I’d held out a little longer, I could’ve gotten it even higher, but time is of the essence. Instead, I managed to get them to sell me the materials I need for enhancement… so, in reality, I didn’t really come out ahead.”
“I suppose it’s only natural that a Hero can do all sorts of things.”
“No, I’m just good at this sort of thing. If I hadn’t been told the market price, I wouldn’t have known either.”
“Naofumi, you’re so amazing!”
Éclair is praising my Father. Well, of course she is. My Father has an excellent sense of money.

In fact, back at that slave village, he arranged everything for Filolial-sama—from her meals to her work—that I brought her there. At the time, I’d planned to cover her living expenses with the materials and food we’d obtained by defeating monsters, but I realized that leaving it to my Father would solve everything.
“I think there will be people who want the items the Shield Hero sold, so I don’t think that deal with the merchant was a bad one.”
“That seems to be the case. The other party didn’t seem too reluctant, which is why they raised the price—I think it turned out to be a win-win, a pleasant transaction for both sides.”
“So in another world, you can’t survive without doing business. That’s a world I know nothing about.”
“It’s not quite like that, though. I… um, do you know anything about video games? I just happened to enjoy doing that sort of thing.”
“Hmm… Judging by what’s happened so far, Lord Iwatani, you’re quite good at supporting others, aren’t you?”

“Is… that so? I actually skim off quite a bit of profit, you know? All things considered, I’m constantly relying on Motoyasu-kun, Sakura-chan, and the others, so it’s kind of frustrating that this is all I can do.”
“Modesty can come across as sarcasm sometimes, Lord Iwatani. Anyway, I feel like I’ve finally grasped what kind of person the Shield Hero is.”
For some reason, Éclair seems to be nodding in agreement. It’s a memory from the future, but I get the feeling Éclair was actively trying to imitate her Father. That’s a good attitude.
“Exactly! Father was also brilliant at stripping bandits of everything they had!”
